name: Configuring and Operating Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop

intro: As a candidate for this exam, you should be a server or desktop administrator with subject matter expertise in designing, implementing, managing, and maintaining Azure Virtual Desktop experiences and remote apps for any device.

You should be able to manage end-user desktop environments, including delivering applications and configuring user settings. You should use the Azure portal, templates, scripting, and command-line tools to manage an Azure Virtual Desktop deployment.
